$comment: Upstream repositories this page indexes. Each is pinned to a commit so a build is reproducible: CI and a laptop generate byte-identical output. build.py --refresh resolves each pin to the current upstream tip and rewrites this file, which is what the fortnightly workflow does. build.py walks each source for SKILL.md files, dedupes by skill name (shallowest path wins, so a repo that mirrors a skill into two directories contributes it once), and prerenders a card for each.

sources.note: Own library. Vendored imports keep their upstream licences; see its THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
Mirrors its skills into both cw/skills and skills; dedupe collapses them.
